name: Shinkai Nagisa
source: The progagonist's kouhai. She is aggressive with a strong sense of justice. In order to help others sometimes she will stir up some trouble, and is treated as a delinquent. But she is in fact very kind and considerate with normal girly interests. Her family runs a karate dojo, she herself is also very strong and has won the national championships.
